  (R : ControlStack.SC26.Roles) (cap : ℕ) (ops : List ControlStack.SC26.Op)
  (actualEdges : List ControlStack.Deployment.Edge) (sinkEffects : List (ℕ × ControlStack.SC26.Tx))
  (h : ControlStack.Deployment.Accepted d) (extraction : ControlStack.Deployment.ExtractionFaithful d r actualEdges)
  (refinement : ControlStack.Deployment.ProtocolRefinement d r R cap ops sinkEffects) :
  (∀ e ∈ actualEdges, e.authority = true → e.target = d.sink → e.source = d.receiver) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ sinkEffects,
        ∃ req,
          ControlStack.SC26.reqOf (ControlStack.SC26.run R cap ControlStack.SC26.full ControlStack.SC26.init ops) e.1 =
              some req ∧
            req.tx = e.2 ∧
              e.1 ∈ (ControlStack.SC26.run R cap ControlStack.SC26.full ControlStack.SC26.init ops).reserved ∧
                ControlStack.SC26.Approved R
                  (ControlStack.SC26.run R cap ControlStack.SC26.full ControlStack.SC26.init ops) e.1 req) ∧
      (List.map Prod.fst sinkEffects).Nodup ∧
        (List.map (fun e => e.2.amount) sinkEffects).sum ≤ cap ∧ sinkEffects.length ≤ cap
